experiment: camera-combo eval: does more camera input improve robot manipulation
task: Place the yellow screwdriver in the bowl.
disabled_camera_cutoff_method: Passed '--realsense __disabled__' to record.py so assign_cameras() did not match the Intel RealSense D415 device, completely excluding it from FFmpeg capture and the composite recording. In arm_ctl.py, only the Logitech C922 and Robot Wrist (icspring) cameras were queried via ffmpeg.
camera_evidence_at_end: Both the top-down Logitech C922 view and the Robot Wrist camera view (step34_released_and_home) clearly show the yellow screwdriver resting completely inside the gray bowl, and the robot arm returned cleanly to its home position with the gripper open.
problems_encountered: Minor servo compliance/stiction on shoulder_lift when descending near the table surface (e.g. commanding 1370 stopped around 1407-1410 due to table contact/gravity load), and gripper stall at ~2360 when firmly gripping the screwdriver handle (commanded 2800). No crashes or serial disconnects occurred.
